claims.text: The French archive describes Fort-Lamy’s establishment after battle. Kano’s institutional account instead records Abbas’s probation, restrictions on palace and title appointments, and later British-supervised offices collecting tax. A post and retained local offices are different relations. These retrospectives do not merge Kano, Sokoto or Kanem-Bornu, establish empty land or turn surrender under conquest into popular consent.
